review_description: Brenton and his offsider did a great job installing our system. He explained all the options and we got a great system.Any issues were quickly dealt with and we got online quickly. We needed to upgrade our switch board and install cabling to the shed. His quote for the size of the job was very reasonable. Highly recommend.

I told Brenton I wanted a system that would fit my shed roof, as large as possible. He measured up the roof and calculated that we could fit an 11kw system. Fitted the tracks and wiring one day and panels and inverter the next. My wife and I are really happy with the system.

I believe because we live in an isolated area we pay a premium for solar supply and installation when compared to a metropolitan area where trades people, materials and supplies are readily available.  Therefore we receive less value for money because the same system installed in the city is about $1500 cheaper.

We have had our system for 2 years and have not had any problems with it.  We had an SMA inverter at a previous home and found it trouble free, so we requested one on this instalation. Our supplier had not used that brand before but was happy to source one for us. We are very satisfied with the product and the service.
